summary: Advances the race start countdown sequence on the vehicle/session object. Clears the in-progress flag each frame, then either resets the timer fields, plays a sound effect and advances the countdown step, or (on the final green-light step) records telemetry while triggering the light sound. Part of the race start system.

operations.description: Clear countdown-in-progress flag (this+0x39EC) to 0 every frame.
If initial block flag byte (this+0x39EE) is nonzero, skip the entire update.
If a2 is zero, reset phase (this+0x3A08), timer (this+0x3A04) and step index (this+0x39F0) to 0 and return early.
Only advance the countdown when float timer (this+0x3A04) is <= 0.0.
Branch on whether a2 is within the current countdown step index (this+0x39F0): valid-step path vs beyond-end path.
Trigger countdown sound effect SoundEffectTrigger_89a0 with object base this+8 on the valid-step path.
Reload countdown timer (this+0x3A04) from the step interval field (this+0x3A00).
Green-light telemetry guard: a2 >= 1, speed threshold (this+0x3578) > 0.0, engine state (this+0x3978) > 0.0, and throttle (this+0x3994) * 0.5 < comparison threshold (this+0x3998).
Record telemetry via PositionUpdateWithTelemetryRecording(this) when the green-light conditions hold.
Trigger the beyond-end countdown sound effect SoundEffectTrigger with object base this+8.
Reload countdown timer (this+0x3A04) from the alternate step interval field (this+0x39FC).
Final-step transition: if a2 == 1 and step index (this+0x39F0) is 0, set phase (this+0x3A08) to 1, step index to 0, in-progress flag (this+0x39EC) to 1, and return early.
Fall-through update: set phase (this+0x3A08) to a2 and reset step index (this+0x39F0) to 0.

clean_pseudocode: if (a2 == 1 && this->step_index == 0) { this->phase = 1; this->step_index = 0; this->countdown_in_progress_flag = 1; return; }
